groups.problem: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1, which gives one page too many when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, so 'next' leads to an empty page.
groups.rationale: All four point to the same off-by-one in totalPages (lines 11-14) and suggest the same Math.ceil fix.

groups.problem: add_members and remove_member call params.require(:group_id), but the member routes supply :id, so these requests raise ParameterMissing.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same mismatch between the route parameter and the controller code, in the same actions.

groups.problem: The public members endpoint now always limits results to 50, but the public members template has no pagination controls, so members beyond 50 are hidden.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same truncation regression in GroupsController#members and the public template that can't page through results.
